name: Ruptured
detailed_description:
Explore a Broken World

After an experiment gone wrong, the world finds itself split in two - but that's no obstacle with the portable INTaCT device! Swap between the similar but slightly different versions of the world to explore the remnants of the mysterious company that caused it all.

Grow more powerful throughout the game by unlocking various abilities, weapons, and upgrades. These will be needed to defeat stronger and stranger enemies, solve interesting puzzles, and overcome platforming challenges!

Modify the experience with augmentation chips, providing powerful bonuses to the player. Attract coins, electrify your shots, and more! Overclock them for even more potent (and more dangerous) effects!

Uncover the secrets of this fractured reality with data logs - small lore snippets that can be found in hard to reach places. 

Craft Your Own Adventure in the Worldbuilder

The Worldbuilder gives access to the tools used to make the main game. Create a challenge, tell a story, or make a puzzle with ease. Share your creations on the Steam Workshop, or download and play other creators' levels. Want to make a bullet hell? Fight 5 bosses at once? Just want to mess around with the game mechanics? The freedom is yours, as nearly all the developer tools will be available in the level editor!

Features:

  • Tilemap editing mode to shape the world

  • Object editing mode to populate it

  • Background editing mode to make it beautiful

  • Channels and logic gates - create puzzles, trigger events, and more! Ruptured is Turing complete!

  • Map editor - connect the world together via level transitions and position sections in the map editor

  • Dialogue editor - create NPC dialogue, signs, and data logs to share your story with the world!

  • Cinematic editor - take control away from the player and make events play out in-game

  • Global data - share information across different sections. Set spawn conditions for objects, open a door somewhere else, etc.

  • Section settings - Change the background, music, lighting, and more!

  • Steam Workshop integration - Publish and download levels on the Steam Workshop!

Challenges

Game not hard enough? Then challenge levels are the thing for you! Beating these challenges will unlock various customization items, including colors, facial expressions, and hats. Go for a fast time to unlock better items, and flex on your friends!
